pre_exercise_source_inventory.source_text_math_marked:
Identifying Basic Toolkit FunctionsIn this text, we will be exploring functions—the shapes of their graphs, their unique characteristics, their algebraic formulas, and how to solve problems with them. When learning to read, we start with the alphabet. When learning to do arithmetic, we start with numbers. When working with functions, it is similarly helpful to have a base set of building-block elements. We call these our “toolkit functions,” which form a set of basic named functions for which we know the graph, formula, and special properties. Some of these functions are programmed to individual buttons on many calculators. For these definitions we will use {{math:fs-id1165137698132:0}} as the input variable and {{math:fs-id1165137698132:1}} as the output variable.
We will see these toolkit functions, combinations of toolkit functions, their graphs, and their transformations frequently throughout this book. It will be very helpful if we can recognize these toolkit functions and their features quickly by name, formula, graph, and basic table properties. The graphs and sample table values are included with each function shown in .

tables.source_summary: The title is “Toolkit functions”. There are three columns and ten rows. The first column is labeled, “name”, the second column is labeled, “function”, and the third column is labeled graph which contains pictures of the functions. The constant function is f(x) = c where c is the constant; the identity function is f(x) = x; the absolute function is f(x)=|x|; the quadratic function is f(x) = x^2; the cubic function is f(x)=x^3; the reciprocal function is f(x)=1/x; the reciprocal squared function is f(x)=1/x^2; the square root function is f(x)=sqrt(x); the cube root function is f(x) = x^(1/3).

Key ConceptsA relation is a set of ordered pairs. A function is a specific type of relation in which each domain value, or input, leads to exactly one range value, or output. See and .
Function notation is a shorthand method for relating the input to the output in the form {{math:fs-id1165137851183:0}} See and .
In tabular form, a function can be represented by rows or columns that relate to input and output values. See .
To evaluate a function, we determine an output value for a corresponding input value. Algebraic forms of a function can be evaluated by replacing the input variable with a given value. See and .
To solve for a specific function value, we determine the input values that yield the specific output value. See .
An algebraic form of a function can be written from an equation. See and .
Input and output values of a function can be identified from a table. See .
Relating input values to output values on a graph is another way to evaluate a function. See .
A function is one-to-one if each output value corresponds to only one input value. See .
A graph represents a function if any vertical line drawn on the graph intersects the graph at no more than one point. See .
The graph of a one-to-one function passes the horizontal line test. See .

problem_records.en_text_math_marked: What is the difference between a relation and a function?
problem_records.id_text_math_marked: Apa perbedaan antara relasi dan fungsi?

source_solution_records.en_text_math_marked: A relation is a set of ordered pairs. A function is a special kind of relation in which no two ordered pairs have the same first coordinate.
source_solution_records.id_text_math_marked: Relasi adalah himpunan pasangan terurut. Fungsi adalah jenis relasi khusus yang di dalamnya tidak ada dua pasangan terurut dengan koordinat pertama yang sama.

problem_records.en_text_math_marked: What is the difference between the input and the output of a function?
problem_records.id_text_math_marked: Apa perbedaan antara masukan dan keluaran suatu fungsi?

problem_records.en_text_math_marked: Why does the vertical line test tell us whether the graph of a relation represents a function?
problem_records.id_text_math_marked: Mengapa uji garis vertikal dapat menunjukkan apakah grafik suatu relasi merepresentasikan fungsi?

source_solution_records.en_text_math_marked: When a vertical line intersects the graph of a relation more than once, that indicates that for that input there is more than one output. At any particular input value, there can be only one output if the relation is to be a function.
source_solution_records.id_text_math_marked: Ketika sebuah garis vertikal memotong grafik suatu relasi lebih dari sekali, hal itu menunjukkan bahwa untuk masukan tersebut terdapat lebih dari satu keluaran. Agar relasi tersebut merupakan fungsi, setiap nilai masukan hanya boleh memiliki satu keluaran.

problem_records.en_text_math_marked: How can you determine if a relation is a one-to-one function?
problem_records.id_text_math_marked: Bagaimana cara menentukan apakah suatu relasi merupakan fungsi satu-ke-satu?

problem_records.en_text_math_marked: Why does the horizontal line test tell us whether the graph of a function is one-to-one?
problem_records.id_text_math_marked: Mengapa uji garis horizontal dapat menunjukkan apakah grafik suatu fungsi bersifat satu-ke-satu?

source_solution_records.en_text_math_marked: When a horizontal line intersects the graph of a function more than once, that indicates that for that output there is more than one input. A function is one-to-one if each output corresponds to only one input.
source_solution_records.id_text_math_marked: Ketika sebuah garis horizontal memotong grafik suatu fungsi lebih dari sekali, hal itu menunjukkan bahwa untuk keluaran tersebut terdapat lebih dari satu masukan. Suatu fungsi bersifat satu-ke-satu jika setiap keluaran hanya bersesuaian dengan satu masukan.

A coordinate plane with x-axis from -3 to 10 and y-axis from 0 to 4. A blue curve starts at (-2,0) and extends to the right, showing increasing positive values, resembling a square root function.
A Cartesian graph displays a blue W-shaped curve, typical of a quartic function. It has a local maximum at (0,1) and two local minima around (-2,-3) and (2,-3), extending upwards symmetrically.

glossary.en_meaning: the set of all possible input values for a relation
glossary.id_meaning: himpunan semua nilai masukan yang mungkin untuk suatu relasi

glossary.en_meaning: a relation in which each input value yields a unique output value
glossary.id_meaning: relasi yang setiap nilai masukannya menghasilkan tepat satu nilai keluaran

glossary.en_meaning: a method of testing whether a function is one-to-one by determining whether any horizontal line intersects the graph more than once
glossary.id_meaning: metode untuk menguji apakah suatu fungsi merupakan fungsi satu-ke-satu dengan menentukan apakah ada garis horizontal yang memotong grafik lebih dari sekali

glossary.en_meaning: each object or value in a domain that relates to another object or value by a relationship known as a function
glossary.id_meaning: setiap objek atau nilai dalam domain yang dihubungkan dengan objek atau nilai lain oleh relasi yang disebut fungsi

glossary.en_meaning: a function for which each value of the output is associated with a unique input value
glossary.id_meaning: fungsi yang setiap nilai keluarannya bersesuaian dengan tepat satu nilai masukan

glossary.en_meaning: each object or value in the range that is produced when an input value is entered into a function
glossary.id_meaning: setiap objek atau nilai dalam range yang dihasilkan ketika suatu nilai masukan dimasukkan ke dalam fungsi

glossary.en_meaning: the set of output values that result from the input values in a relation
glossary.id_meaning: himpunan nilai keluaran yang dihasilkan oleh nilai masukan dalam suatu relasi

glossary.en_meaning: a method of testing whether a graph represents a function by determining whether a vertical line intersects the graph no more than once
glossary.id_meaning: metode untuk menguji apakah suatu grafik merepresentasikan fungsi dengan menentukan apakah setiap garis vertikal memotong grafik paling banyak sekali
